Interface GameEvent

All Known Implementing Classes:
GameEvent.CardAcquired, GameEvent.CardAcquisitionFailed, GameEvent.CardSlotReady, GameEvent.EraChanged, GameEvent.EventResolved, GameEvent.GameEnded, GameEvent.PostRoundStarted, GameEvent.RoundEnded, GameEvent.RoundStarted, GameEvent.TotemPlaced, GameEvent.TotemReturnedToTurnOrder
public sealed interface GameEvent permits GameEvent.RoundStarted, GameEvent.TotemPlaced, GameEvent.CardSlotReady, GameEvent.CardAcquired, GameEvent.CardAcquisitionFailed, GameEvent.TotemReturnedToTurnOrder, GameEvent.PostRoundStarted, GameEvent.EventResolved, GameEvent.EraChanged, GameEvent.RoundEnded, GameEvent.GameEnded
Domain events published by Game to its registered listeners. All data carried by events is immutable (PlayerSnapshot, CardSnapshot, BoardSnapshot, OfferTileSnapshot, TurnOrderTileSnapshot). Listeners never receive direct references to model objects and therefore cannot alter game state. Each event carries everything the Controller and View need to react, so the Controller never needs to query the model after receiving an event: - RoundStarted carries the full turn order and a BoardSnapshot. - TotemPlaced carries the updated BoardSnapshot. - TotemReturnedToTurnOrder carries the updated BoardSnapshot. - CardSlotReady carries the available cards inline. - PostRoundStarted carries Watchtower players and available cards inline. Player tribes (acquired characters and buildings) travel inside{ PlayerSnapshot}, so any event that already carries a player snapshot also carries that player's up-to-date tribe.
